title: Topic 4: Describing People - Vocabulary
description: Core words for describing people: tall, short, long, hair, eyes, nice. 8 tap exercises with embedded grammar.
canDoStatement: Describe a person's appearance and personality simply
introductionText:
tall = a big person (up!)  |  short = a small person
long = long hair (down to the back)
hair = on your head  |  eyes = you see with them
nice = a good, friendly person
+ phrase bank: He is tall | She has long hair |
What does he look like?

grammarBlocks.title: TO BE + adjective (He is tall) + HAVE / HAS for features (Sh
grammarBlocks.explanation: TO BE + adjective (He is tall) + HAVE / HAS for features (She has long hair)
patterns: to be + adjective (is tall / is nice)
have vs has (I/you HAVE - he/she HAS)

questions.question: Tap the missing word: My sister has very ___ hair - down to her back!
Tap the missing word: My teacher is very ___. I like her!
Which word is NOT for describing people?
A: What does your brother look like? B: ___
options: He is tall and he has short hair
questions.correctAnswer: He is tall and he has short hair

questions.question: Grammar: My mother ___ short. My parents ___ very nice.
Grammar: I ___ short hair. My sister ___ long hair.

explanations.A1-T04-VOC-Q1: Tall = big up! People are tall. Hair is long.
explanations.A1-T04-VOC-Q2: Eyes = for seeing. Hair = on your head.
explanations.A1-T04-VOC-Q3: Hair is LONG or SHORT. People are TALL or SHORT.
explanations.A1-T04-VOC-Q5: Email is from Topic 2 - not a description word.
explanations.A1-T04-VOC-Q6: What does he LOOK LIKE? asks about appearance.
explanations.A1-T04-VOC-Q7: She IS (one person). They ARE (two or more).
